title: Demand Estimation with Unobserved Stockout Substitution: Exact Likelihood Maximization
abstract: arXiv:2610.34547v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a product is sold out, customers who prefer it may buy a substitute or leave without purchasing. Efficient demand estimation in this setting is challenging when inventory is observed only at replenishments, because the stockout times, and hence the products available to each customer, are unobserved. Estimating demand efficiently under stockout substitution has been a challenging problem since Anupindi et al. (1998), and it has become more pressing as the scale of such problem instances grows thanks to innovations in retailing such as unmanned stores. We provide a complete solution to this problem for the multinomial logit (MNL) model, the most widely used model of customer choice. Using a continuous-time representation of the purchase process developed in Zhou et al. translated_title: 具有未观测缺货替代的需求估计：精确似然最大化
translated_abstract: 当产品售罄时，偏好该产品的顾客可能会购买替代品，或者不购买而离开。当仅在补货时才能观测到库存信息时，这一场景下的高效需求估计极具挑战性，因为缺货时间以及每位顾客面对的可选产品集合都是未观测的。自Anupindi等人（1998）以来，在缺货替代下高效估计需求一直是一个具有挑战性的问题，而随着无人商店等零售创新使此类问题实例的规模不断扩大，这个问题变得更加紧迫。我们针对多项Logit（MNL）模型——最广泛使用的顾客选择模型——为该问题提供了完整的解决方案。利用Zhou等人（2026）开发的购买过程连续时间表示，我们证明无论涉及多少产品、顾客或缺货事件，精确似然及其梯度都可以表示为一维积分。
tldr: 该论文针对缺货时间未观测的缺货替代需求估计难题，在MNL选择模型下利用购买过程的连续时间表示，证明精确似然及其梯度均可化为一维积分，从而给出了该问题自1998年提出以来的完整解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a complete solution to demand estimation under unobserved stockout substitution for the MNL model, showing that the exact likelihood and its gradient reduce to one-dimensional integrals regardless of the number of products, customers, or stockouts.
